SELECT l.room_id, l.stay_date, sum(l.delta)::int AS ledger_delta, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_occupancy o WHERE o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.hotel_id = l.hotel_id AND o.room_id = l.room_id AND o.kind = 'RESERVATION' AND o.status IN ('HELD', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') AND o.stay_range @> l.stay_date ) AS occupied FROM inventory_ledger l WHERE l.tenant_id = #{w.tenantId} AND l.hotel_id = #{w.hotelId} AND l.effect_kind = 'RESERVATION' AND l.stay_date >= #{w.from}::date AND l.stay_date < #{w.to}::date
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM physical_room pr WHERE pr.id = l.room_id AND pr.room_type_id = #{w.roomTypeId} )
GROUP BY l.tenant_id, l.hotel_id, l.room_id, l.stay_date HAVING sum(l.delta) <> (CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_occupancy o WHERE o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.hotel_id = l.hotel_id AND o.room_id = l.room_id AND o.kind = 'RESERVATION' AND o.status IN ('HELD', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN') AND o.stay_range @> l.stay_date ) THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)
